Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms; weekdays 08:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–13:00. Twelve nurses (three shifts), four admin. Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit.

Attendance ~180/day, peaking at 310 (Jan 2025 flu wave). No-shows 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Key incidents: March 2024 vaccine fridge failure (€2,100 lost) — now networked alarm plus paper backup; November 2024 concurrent record edit overwrote an allergy field — records now lock when open.

Rules: no prescription renewal without a consultation in 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day.

Second ultrasound postponed pending an undone utilisation study. Nursing coordinator vacant since August 2025; two senior nurses rotate cover — unsustainable beyond winter.
